notes: John O'Reilly's Confetti conference app — the Wear OS catalog, the sibling of joreilly-confetti-mobile. Same reasoning as that import: Confetti already applies ee.schimke.composeai.preview and publishes design-artifacts/confetti-wear from its own workflow, so this is an independent second path rather than the only one. The spec is the upstream catalog.spec.json (Confetti's root spec is the WEAR one; the phone sheet is catalog.mobile.spec.json) with `system` repointed at this slug. Wear is dark-first and round, so the spec carries smallRound/largeRound breakpoints and modes: [dark]. Android/Robolectric lane: these are AndroidX @Preview functions in wearApp/src/main. Split from the mobile catalog because the pipeline renders one module per import.
